info.title: Telleo API
info.description: Start AI phone calls, or connect your counsellors to contacts, from your own systems and get each call's outcome back. Manage your counsellors and AI agents from the same API.

post.description:
Queues a call to one number and dials it as soon as a line is free and calling hours allow. Returns the call at once (usually `queued` or `dialing`); the outcome arrives on your webhook, or poll `GET /calls/{id}`.

Scope: `calls:write`.

post.description:
Queues up to 1,000 calls in one request. Each row is checked on its own: valid rows are queued, invalid rows come back in `rejected` with the row's `index`. Batch calls are dialled as lines free up, behind single calls.

Scope: `calls:write`.

error.message: A batch holds at most 1000 calls; split it.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retrying the same request with the same key returns the first response (200, `idempotent_replay: true`) instead of queueing the calls again; a different request is refused (409 `idempotency_key_reused`), and a retry while the first request is still running gets 409 `request_in_progress`. At most 251 characters. Honoured for 24 hours.

post.description:
Makes a person a counsellor of your account. A NEW email gets a dashboard login (active at once) and, unless `send_welcome_email` is false, the welcome email with their username and password. An email whose login belongs to another account on the platform (or to none) is refused with `409 email_in_use_elsewhere`, so your key never sees someone else's details. The login of a person removed from your account earlier is reused: the counsellor role is added back, their name, mobile number and password stay as they are, and no email is sent. The API only ever grants the counsellor role.

Scope: `counsellors:manage`.

ApiKey.name: X-API-Key
ApiKey.description: Your AI calling API key (`vak_call_…`). `Authorization: Bearer <key>` also works.

RequestId.description: Unique id of this request. Quote it to support.

code.description: Machine-readable code. Branch on this, not on the message.

message.description: A sentence you can log or show to an operator.

request_id.description: Quote this when you contact support.

details.description: Extra context, e.g. `errors: [{field, message}]` for validation errors or `call_id` for conflicts.

name.description: How the agent addresses the person. Fills `{{name}}` in the agent's script.

external_id.description: Your own id for this person or lead (CRM record id). Echoed back and filterable on `GET /calls`.

agent_id.description: The agent that makes the call. Required on `POST /calls`; on a batch row it overrides the batch's `agent_id`. List yours with `GET /agents`.

phone_number.description: E.164, e.g. `+919876543210`. Spaces, dashes, dots and brackets are ignored; a leading `00` is read as `+`.

variables.description: Values for the `{{placeholders}}` in the agent's script. Keys: a letter, then letters, digits, `_` or spaces, at most 40 characters. Values: text, number or boolean, at most 500 characters. A key named like a built-in placeholder (`name`, `lead_name`, `date`, `time`, `year`…) is kept but never replaces the built-in value; the response then carries a `reserved_variable` warning.

metadata.description: Anything you want back on the call and its webhook (at most 8 KB as JSON). The agent never sees it.

test.description: Simulate the call: no phone rings and nothing is billed. It completes at once with a sample outcome and fires your webhook.

Outcome.description: What the AI took from the conversation. `null` until it has been processed (usually within a minute of the call ending), and for calls that did not connect.

call_quality.description: `failed` when the call broke down on our side; then `disposition` is `Incomplete` and `lead_rating` is null. Call the contact again rather than changing their stage.

disposition.description: The agent's label for how the call went, from the dispositions configured on the agent (e.g. Interested, Not interested, Call back later).

answers.description: Each of the agent's extraction questions and the answer given.

lead_rating.description: The AI's 1–10 score of the contact's interest; `null` when it could not tell.

callback_time_text.description: When the contact asked to be called back, in their words (e.g. `tomorrow after 6 pm`).

follow_up.description: Whether a person should call this contact: `CALL` (now), `CALL_LATER` or `SKIP`. `null` when not assessed; never read `null` as `CALL`.

follow_up_note.description: One sentence on why, for the person deciding whether to call (at most 240 characters).

meeting.description: A meeting, demo, visit or callback the contact AGREED to at a specific day or time. `requested` is false when no time was agreed.

at.description: ISO-8601 with offset, resolved from what was said, e.g. `2026-10-14T18:00:00+05:30`.

time_text.description: The contact's own words, e.g. `tomorrow 6 pm`.

status_reason.description: Why a call is waiting or did not happen, in plain words. Present only when there is one.

scheduled_for.description: Present while a queued call is held until a later time (outside calling hours, a recall gap, the daily limit).

recording_url.description: A temporary link to the recording. Fetch the call again for a fresh link after `recording_expires_at`.

cost.description: What the call cost, once it has ended. `null` while it is still running.

credits.description: Credits charged. 0 for test calls and calls that did not connect.

billed.description: false while a charge for this call is still to be made (call minutes, then AI minutes once the outcome is processed), usually a few minutes after it ends.

idempotent_replay.description: Only on `POST /calls`: `true` when this is the call created by an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

warnings.description: Only on `POST /calls`, and only when there is something to say. The call was created either way.

Warning.description: Something in the request that was accepted but may not do what you expect.

message.example: {{date}} in the agent's script is always filled with the current date and time; this value does not replace it. The agent receives it only as information about the contact.

agent_id.description: Only when the row named an agent other than the batch's.

code.description: `call_not_placed` only in a replay: the first request with this `Idempotency-Key` did not place the row; send it again in a new batch.

call_id.description: For `call_already_queued`: the call already waiting for this number.

idempotent_replay.description: `true` when this is the batch created by an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

uses_contact_name.description: The script says the contact's name: send `contact.name`.

variables.description: Placeholders the script uses that you should send in `variables`.

can_place_calls.description: false when new real calls would be refused with 402.

calls_waiting.description: Calls queued and not yet dialled (API and dashboard).

calls_not_yet_billed.description: Calls with a charge still to be made (call minutes, or AI minutes once the outcome is processed). Calls that are never charged are not counted.

human_calls.description: Human (counsellor) calls in the same range: with `source=api` those placed through `POST /human-calls`, with `source=all` every outbound counsellor call placed on Vacademy Voice, Exotel or Airtel (uploaded recordings of calls made elsewhere are not counted). Only Vacademy Voice talk time is charged.

secret.description: The signing secret. Returned only when the endpoint is first set and when the secret is rotated. Store it.

secret_hint.description: First and last characters of the secret, on reads.

id.description: Same on every retry of this event. Use it to ignore duplicates.

can_call.description: Whether this person can take a human call right now on your calling provider.

blocked_reason.description: Why `can_call` is false, e.g. no mobile number on their profile (Vacademy Voice, Exotel) or no Airtel extension mapped.

mobile_number.description: Only on `GET /counsellors/{id}` (and write responses) for keys with `counsellors:manage`, and `null` when the login also belongs to another account (`shared_account`). Digits with the country code, as stored on the profile.

airtel_extension.description: Only on single-counsellor responses, for keys with `counsellors:manage`.

manageable.description: Only for `counsellors:manage` keys: whether the API may change this person (their roles here are counsellor roles only). Admins and other staff are `false`.

shared_account.description: Only for `counsellors:manage` keys: the login also belongs to another account on the platform, so its name and mobile number cannot be changed through the API.

counsellor_id.description: The counsellor to ring, from `GET /counsellors`. Send this or `counsellor_email`, not both.

counsellor_email.description: The counsellor's email in your account (case-insensitive).

phone_number.description: The contact to connect, E.164. Formatting is ignored as for AI calls.

metadata.description: Anything you want back on the call and its webhooks (at most 8 KB as JSON).

analyze.description: Transcribe and analyse the call once its recording is in (0.15 credits per recorded minute). You get `human_call.analysis_ready`.

HumanCallAnalysis.description: AI analysis of the conversation. Fields beyond `status` are present once it is `completed`.

reason.description: With `failed`: `not_connected`, `no_recording`, `insufficient_credits`, `empty_transcript`, `analysis_error`… A temporary error is retried (up to 4 attempts) and stays `pending` meanwhile.

short_update.description: A few words for a list view.

inferred_goal.description: What the counsellor was trying to achieve, inferred from the conversation.

outcome.description: The call's outcome in a word or two, e.g. `interested`.

counsellor_rating.description: How well the counsellor pursued the call's goal (0–10).

HumanCallDisposition.description: The outcome recorded by the counsellor or by you. `null` until set.

status_reason.description: Why a call failed, in plain words. Present only when there is one.

no_answer_by.description: Only on `no_answer` / `busy`: which phone did not pick up, when the provider says so.

crm_lead_linked.description: The call was filed on the one lead in your account with this number (it shows on the lead's timeline).

status_updates.description: How live `status` is on your provider: Vacademy Voice `realtime`, Exotel `final_only`, Airtel `delayed` (after its call record is imported).

answered_at.description: When the contact picked up, when known.

recording_url.description: A temporary link to the recording (24 hours). Fetch the call again for a fresh link.

cost.description: `null` while the call runs. Only Vacademy Voice talk time is charged to your credits; Exotel and Airtel bill you directly.

note.description: Present when the call ran on your own carrier account.

idempotent_replay.description: Only on `POST /human-calls`: `true` when this is the call created by an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

changes_lead_status.description: Setting this disposition moves a linked lead to `lead_status`.

id.description: `evt_hc_…` for the call's own event, `evt_hca_…` for `analysis_ready`. Same on every retry.

created.description: `true` when this request made the person a counsellor here; `false` when they already were (nothing changed).

existing_account.description: The email already had a login on the platform: it was reused, its name, mobile and password were not changed, and no email was sent.

effects.description: On deactivation / reactivation: what else changed (see the counsellors guide).

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes about what was (not) done, e.g. `mobile_number_missing`.

email.description: Their dashboard login. An email whose login belongs to another account is refused (`email_in_use_elsewhere`); the login of someone removed from your account earlier is reused (see `existing_account`).

mobile_number.description: E.164. Their phone rings first on a human call, so Vacademy Voice and Exotel need it (a warning says so when it is missing). Ignored for an existing account.

airtel_extension.description: Their Airtel IQ extension, when your calling provider is Airtel. Unique in your account.

send_welcome_email.description: Email a NEW account its login (username, password, dashboard link). Never sent to an existing account.

name.description: Only for a login that belongs to your account alone (else `409 shared_account`).
